text:
Priya: Quick ops thread for Tuesday's 9:30am PT webinar. Need a final bullet list: reg page variant, Zoom settings + local backup, RTMP failover, upload naming, HubSpot webhook, and post-event tagging. Who picks which?

Marcus: I'll take Zoom + uploads. Plan: cloud recording (separate active speaker + gallery + shared screen), enable audio transcription (VTT), record locally with OBS as host backup. Configure RTMP fallback to StreamYard if Zoom's cloud fails. Keep 'Only authenticated users' OFF. Add co-host Lina.

Lina: I'm on the registration page & confirmation email. Two variants live: Variant A uses "Watch the benchmark" CTA, Variant B uses "Schedule a demo" CTA. Required fields = email, company, job_title. Hidden fields = utm_source, utm_campaign, gclid. Form GUID: will paste after staging publish. Tagging event key: webinar_launch_0624.

Theo: Editing & social. Deliverables: one 90s highlight, three 30s social cuts (format 16:9 + 9:16), captions in SRT, and a plain .txt transcript. Naming convention: WL0624_raw_cloud.mp4, WL0624_raw_local.mp4, WL0624_transcript.txt. Please include speaker timestamps.txt with ranges for clips.

Marcus: Upload flow (post-event): 1) Download cloud MP4 + VTT 2) Collect local OBS MP4 3) Upload both to S3 at s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026-06-24-launch/raw/ 4) Generate signed URL for replay (30d) 5) Create Drive editor folder and invite Theo. I'll set ACL to marketing-editors.

Marcus: Quick upload commands (manual):
```
aws s3 cp "WL0624_cloud.mp4" "s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026-06-24-launch/raw/WL0624_raw_cloud.mp4" --acl bucket-owner-full-control
aws s3 cp "WL0624_local.mp4" "s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026-06-24-launch/raw/WL0624_raw_local.mp4"
aws s3 cp "transcript.vtt" "s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026-06-24-launch/raw/WL0624_transcript.vtt"
```

RecorderBot: Recording started by host Marcus at 09:31 AM PT. Cloud recording enabled.

Priya: HubSpot mapping draft for ops:
- hs_form_id: 1a2b3c4d
- fields: [email, firstname, lastname, company, job_title, utm_source, utm_campaign, gclid]
- lead_owner: assign_to_queue(marketing_webinars)
- contact_tag: webinar_launch_0624
Also add a Zapier webhook to push immediate leads to Slack channel #marketing-leads: https://hooks.zapier.com/hooks/catch/xxxxx/yyy

Theo: For editors: please give me both cloud and local MP4s. I'll prefer local for camera cuts (higher FPS). I will convert VTT->SRT and also produce burned-caption masters. Timestamps.txt format ok.

Priya: Post-event cadence recommendation:
- 1h after: private replay email with 2-line recap + 30-day signed replay link + scheduler CTA
- 24h after: highlights email with 3 clips + one key metric as hook
- 48h after: full edited recording, transcript (.txt) & blog summary
- 7 days: send asset library + SDR handoff with MQL list (criteria: company size >50 && role in ["Engineering","Platform"]) 

Marcus: I'll create signed S3 URL and paste into the 1h email draft. Also will set bucket lifecycle so raw persists 120 days.

Lina: Confirmation email variants: Variant A includes calendar invite + prep doc; Variant B includes calendar + product one-pager. I will report variant CTR after 48h.

Theo: Quick note on social: prioritize metric "reduced p99 latency by 35%" as clip hook. Need both square and vertical renders.

Priya: Owners recap: Reg page & tracking = Lina; Zoom + uploads = Marcus; Clips & editing = Theo; Cadence + replay copy = Priya. Deadline: raw files uploaded and Drive link posted within 90 minutes of webinar end; first clip drafts in 36 hours.

Marcus: I'll add co-host Lina now and verify RTMP fallback. Reminder: if cloud recording fails, StreamYard will have a copy and OBS local will always exist on host laptop.

RecorderBot: Recording ended at 10:42 AM PT. Cloud recording available at https://zoom.us/rec/share/EXAMPLE_WL0624 (access restricted).
